category_title: Students with AS/ADHD experiencing sensory overload and executive function difficulties
scenario_title: Sensory overload during classroom instruction and exams
minimal_context: The student is taking a written exam in a general classroom setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your paper and begin writing your answers for the exam.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have a hard time with handwritten exams. Can I type this on the computer instead? That suits me better.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just stick to the paper for today. Do your best to focus on the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Mmm, well some said that I could kind of go to another room and do the assignments, but that didn't provide the right support anyway. I just want to use the computer.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to stay in the classroom right now. Just try to ignore the background noise and keep writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't. I have always found it difficult if there are sounds, for example sounds from fans and air conditioners or such. I can concentrate on the noise from the air conditioner and completely lose concentration of anything else.
